episodes.synopsis: The replica Nao goes to school in Sunao's place when the basketball star Shuya joins the literature club.

episodes.title: A Replica Stumbles

episodes.synopsis: While Sunao and Shuya tour Kyoto on their school trip, Nao and Aki embark on a journey to Ryo's hometown.
episodes.title: A Replica Travels
